description.en: Validates and tests Near-RT RIC systems.
description.zh: Near-RT RIC 系統驗證與測試。

title.en: What do you want to validate today?

subtitle.en: Describe a Near-RT RIC scenario, paste a pcap / log, or pick a starter below.
subtitle.zh: 描述你的 Near-RT RIC 驗測情境，貼上 pcap / log，或挑一個下面的起手式。

desc.en: Cites O-RAN WG3 documents and section numbers — no hand-waving.
desc.zh: 引用 O-RAN WG3 文件與章節，不憑印象講規格。

desc.en: Paste E2AP / A1 messages or upload pcap — agent walks the flow and flags deviations.
desc.zh: 貼上 E2AP / A1 訊息或上傳 pcap，幫你走流程、找不合規處。

desc.en: Per E2 procedure or E2SM, with pre-conditions, steps, expected results, pass/fail.
desc.zh: 針對 E2 程序或 E2SM 產出前置、步驟、預期結果、pass/fail。

label.zh: 幫我寫 E2 Setup 一致性測試

prompt.en: Generate a conformance test plan for the E2 Setup procedure between Near-RT RIC and an E2 Node. Cover success, reject, and timeout cases. Cite the relevant O-RAN.WG3.E2AP sections.
prompt.zh: 幫我針對 Near-RT RIC ↔ E2 Node 的 E2 Setup 程序產出一份一致性測試計畫，涵蓋成功、reject、timeout 三種情境，並標出對應的 O-RAN.WG3.E2AP 章節。

label.zh: 幫我看 KPM xApp 的訂閱

prompt.en: I will paste my KPM xApp's RIC Subscription Request (ASN.1 / hex / JSON). Walk the message, point out any spec deviations, and suggest a minimal indication-handling skeleton.
prompt.zh: 我會貼我的 KPM xApp RIC Subscription Request（ASN.1 / hex / JSON）。請幫我走訊息、指出不合規處，並給一份最小的 Indication 處理骨架。

label.en: Diff O-RAN SC vs FlexRIC on E2 Setup
label.zh: 比對 O-RAN SC 與 FlexRIC 的 E2 Setup

prompt.en: Compare how O-RAN SC RIC and FlexRIC implement the E2 Setup procedure: message fields populated, default timer values, behaviour on E2 Reset. Highlight interop risks.
prompt.zh: 比較 O-RAN SC RIC 與 FlexRIC 在 E2 Setup 程序上的差異：填了哪些欄位、預設 timer、遇到 E2 Reset 的行為。標出可能的互通風險。

prompt.en: I will upload a pcap containing E2AP traffic. Identify the procedures, measure RIC Indication end-to-end latency, and flag any malformed or out-of-sequence messages.
prompt.zh: 我會上傳一份含 E2AP 流量的 pcap。請辨識其中的程序、量 RIC Indication 端到端延遲，並標出格式錯誤或順序錯亂的訊息。
